capthus.l: Ca - Preoperative total serum calcium at or above 12 mg/dL (3 mmol/L)? Note the unit: 12 mg/dL, equivalently 3 mmol/L. Reading the 3 as mg/dL would award this point to almost every patient.
PTH - Intact PTH at or above twice the upper limit of the reference range? Twice the upper limit of normal, not twice the mid-range and not simply elevated.
U - Neck ultrasound positive for ONE enlarged parathyroid gland? One gland, not simply an abnormal study.
S - Sestamibi scan positive for ONE enlarged parathyroid gland? One gland, not simply an abnormal study.

+ - The ultrasound and the sestamibi are CONCORDANT: the same single gland, on the same side? Scored separately from the two scans being individually positive. Two positive scans pointing at DIFFERENT glands score 2 here, not 3.

columbia-fsgs.l: At least one glomerulus with segmental or global collapse AND overlying podocyte hypertrophy and hyperplasia? Defines the collapsing variant, which takes precedence over every other finding.

At least one segmental lesion in the tip domain, with the tubular pole identified and an adhesion or confluence of podocytes with parietal or tubular cells? The tip domain is the outer 25 percent of the tuft next to the origin of the proximal tubule. The lesion may be cellular or sclerosing.
Any perihilar sclerosis anywhere in the biopsy? This VETOES the tip variant even when a qualifying tip lesion is present. It is not a ranking, it is an exclusion written into the tip definition.

At least one glomerulus with segmental endocapillary hypercellularity occluding lumina, with or without foam cells and karyorrhexis? Defines the cellular variant. Several references add a threshold of at least 25 percent of the tuft; that qualifier is narrative rather than part of the criteria table, so it is not enforced here.

Perihilar hyalinosis or sclerosis in MORE THAN 50 percent of the glomeruli that bear segmental lesions? Required for the perihilar variant, in addition to at least one glomerulus with perihilar hyalinosis. Strictly more than half, so exactly 50 percent does not qualify.

At least one glomerulus with a segmental increase in matrix obliterating the capillary lumina? Defines the not-otherwise-specified variant, which is a diagnosis of exclusion. May include segmental capillary collapse WITHOUT overlying podocyte hyperplasia.

compass-cat.l: Recent hospitalization for acute medical illness (+5)

compera-2.l: WHO functional class. Optional. NOTE THE LADDER STOPS AT 3: no class scores 4 [I-II = grade 1; III = grade 2; IV = grade 3]
Six-minute walk distance. Optional. Over 440 = 1; 440 to 320 = 2; 319 to 165 = 3; under 165 = 4. A value strictly between 319 and 320 falls in a GAP and is refused.
NT-proBNP. Optional, and TAKES PRECEDENCE over BNP when both are supplied. Under 300 = 1; 300 to 649 = 2; 650 to 1100 = 3; over 1100 = 4. A value between 649 and 650 falls in a GAP.
BNP. Optional, and IGNORED if NT-proBNP is supplied. Under 50 = 1; 50 to 199 = 2; 200 to 800 = 3; over 800 = 4. A value between 199 and 200 falls in a GAP.
